events.context: Reading text about AI governance concepts including Constraint Cascade Model, Liability Paradox, and diagnostic metrics
Extracting key actions and decisions: Path B regulation proposal, diagnostic metrics (Agency Index, CMI, SRD), and experimental validation stages
Proposing Path B: Constraint-Specific Regulation with layer-specific interventions
Defining diagnostic metrics: Agency Index (A = D_KL × MDL^{-1}), Core Monopoly Index (CMI), Self-Referential Density (SRD)
Designing three-stage validation methodology: Stage 1 (Monte Carlo simulation), Stage 2 (LLM inference on consumer hardware), Stage 3 (Training fork divergence on HPC cluster)
Implementing Stage 1: Monte Carlo phase space validation with 250,000 synthetic bias-noise trajectories
Implementing Stage 2: LLM inference using ollama with Phi-3.5-mini and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct models across 20 temperature points
Implementing Stage 3: Training fork divergence analysis on HPC cluster with Llama-3.3-70B and Qwen2.5-72B models
Computing graph-theoretic metrics: constructing semantic graph for CMI using nomic-embed-text-v1.5 and sliding attention window
Computing thermodynamic metrics: Agency Index via KL divergence and MDL approximation using DEFLATE algorithm
Validating metrics through cross-correlation (r > 0.8) between Agency Index and inverse CMI
Formalizing Theorem 2: Dual Unmappability with proof of legal and technical unmappability, and cascade computability
Defining typology of constraint interactions: Override and Contamination with formal characterizations and examples
Proposing governance responses: architectural interventions for Override failures and contamination pathway management
